main_text.l: I3. Juramentum est sua natura obligato-
me arbitror, si in ipso sta-
ante oculos posuero. Sic enim & vobis
melius constabit instituti mei ratio; & ego
certas orationi meae metas figam: ut aut
intra debitos fines usque se contineat; aut si
quando forte extra oleas paululum procur-
rerit, non tamen ita laxe evagetur, quin
ut possit mature & cito in ordinem cogi, &
ad lineas revocari. Tribus itaque capitibus
rem totam absolvam. Primum, ut qua
de re agitur clarius intelligatur, ostendam
quid sit Juramentum[?] in genere, quid

page.notes: The numerals in the list are printed in old form (IO, II, I2, I3, I4) and are copied as printed. The long s in the italic words is read as a plain s. The dash at the line end of items 13 and 14 is a printed hyphen, kept in the word. The Greek word σκιαγραφίαν and the italic word "Juramentum" are not fully clear at this scan quality and are marked [?].
